title: Personal data, the NDPA 2023 and choosing a lawful basis

say: Personal data, the Nigeria Data Protection Act, and choosing a lawful basis.
This is the video for Module 1 of Digital Privacy and Data Protection.
Data protection is about people, not computers.
A customer list, a WhatsApp group, a register of students, a payroll sheet and a box of paper forms all hold information about real people.

say: Personal data is any information that can point to one person. A phone number, a photo, a BVN, a home address or a voice note can all do it, alone or combined with other details.

panel.heading: Data protection is about people

say: Some data is sensitive, because misuse can cause serious harm. Health, religious beliefs, ethnic origin, political opinions and fingerprints are examples. Sensitive data needs a stronger reason and stronger protection.

say: Before you decide who must do what, name the three roles correctly. The data subject is the person the data is about, like a customer who orders a gown.

cards.d: The person the data is about. For example, a customer who orders a gown from a tailor.
Decides why and how data is used. The tailoring business that keeps measurements and phone numbers.
Handles data for the controller, on its instructions. A bookkeeper or a cloud app the tailor uses.

say: The data controller decides why and how the data is used. Here, the tailoring business. The controller carries the main responsibility.

cards.d: The person the data is about. For example, a customer who orders a gown from a tailor.
Decides why and how data is used. The tailoring business that keeps measurements and phone numbers.
Handles data for the controller, on its instructions. A bookkeeper or a cloud app the tailor uses.

say: The data processor handles the data on the controller's behalf, such as a bookkeeper or a cloud app. A processor must follow instructions, keep data secure and report problems quickly.

say: The NDPC can impose fines. The maximum is the greater of 2% of annual gross revenue, or a fixed sum. Let us work it out for Halima's lesson centre in Kaduna.

card.title: Halima's maximum fine
card.note: These are maximums, not automatic fines.

say: Her revenue last year was about 45 million naira. 2% of that is 900,000 naira.

card.title: Halima's maximum fine
card.note: These are maximums, not automatic fines.

say: The fixed figure for a business not of major importance is 2,000,000 naira. For organisations of major importance it is 10,000,000 naira.

card.title: Halima's maximum fine
card.note: These are maximums, not automatic fines.

say: The law uses whichever is greater, so her ceiling is 2,000,000 naira.
That is far more than the cost of a lockable cupboard, a password manager and a short staff briefing.

say: Every use of personal data needs a lawful basis, chosen and written down before you collect. Work down these questions in order.
First, define the exact purpose in one sentence.

panel.heading: Choosing a lawful basis
items: Is it needed for their contract?

say: Does a law require it? Keeping staff pay records for tax is a legal obligation.

panel.heading: Choosing a lawful basis
items: Is it needed for their contract?

say: Is it needed to deliver what the person asked for? A delivery address for an order is contract.

panel.heading: Choosing a lawful basis
items: Is it needed for their contract?

say: Is there a genuine business interest that does not override the person's rights, like basic fraud checks? That is legitimate interests. Record your reasoning.

panel.heading: Choosing a lawful basis
items: Is it needed for their contract?

say: If none of these fits, ask for clear consent, for example to join a marketing list.

panel.heading: Choosing a lawful basis
items: Is it needed for their contract?

say: And remember the principles, such as collecting only what you need. A school with a good reason to collect parents' numbers still breaks the rules if it puts every parent in one big WhatsApp group.

panel.heading: Choosing a lawful basis
items: Is it needed for their contract?
panel.rule: A lawful basis never excuses breaking a principle.

say: Consent is often used when another basis fits better, and it is often done badly. Valid consent is clear, in plain language, separate from other terms, and provable. Withdrawing should be as easy as giving it.

panel.heading: Is this consent valid?
left: You can prove it was given
right: Saying no costs a needed service

say: Silence, inactivity or a pre-ticked box is never consent. And if saying no would cost the person a service they need, consent is not truly free, so look for another basis.

panel.heading: Is this consent valid?
left: You can prove it was given
right: Saying no costs a needed service

say: To remember. Personal data is anything that can identify a person. Name the three roles first. The NDPA is enforced by the NDPC.
Choose and record a lawful basis before you collect. And storing data on servers abroad is a transfer, which needs a lawful condition too.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Personal data is anything that can identify a person
Name subject, controller and processor first
NDPA 2023 is enforced by the NDPC
Choose and record a lawful basis before collecting
Data on servers abroad is a transfer
